task.description:
WF-02 шаг 1b, часть REQ-007 (ворота на CODE-DESIGNER). Проверьте docs/design/REQ-001-pixel-office.md в части REQ-007 (офис): разделы 2.3, 3.5–3.8, 4.4–4.7, 10.2 (тесты LY и OF), 10.4 (шаги UAT, особенно U3 — проверка в настоящем Chrome), 10.6 (мутанты), 14 (план реализации) и приложение A (P9) — критерии REQ-007 (8 штук) и общая модель, на которую опирается офис. Проверьте сами, не по отчёту проектировщика: (1) каждый критерий REQ-007 закрыт названным тестом, командой или шагом, и название реально существует; (2) в дизайне нет кода реализации; (3) по дизайну можно строить без догадок: состав офиса, состояния, перемещения, сетка и поиск пути (BFS, проходимость как в эталоне reference/pixel-office-osnova/tests/layout.js), карточка агента, разметка и надписи как контракт между index.html, app.js и тестами; (4) офис считается только из журнала и не хранит собственных событий, режим симуляции отдельный и помечен (R2, AP-002), страница только читает; (5) правила страницы REQ-001 (CSP, никаких inline-обработчиков, каждый <script> с src, только ES-модули) применены к файлам офиса; (6) write set REQ-007 внутри объявленного ORCH (tools/src/pixel-office/, tools/test/pixel-office-*.test.js и т. д.) и не трогает tools/src/snapshot.js, cli.js, .claude/agents/; (7) нагрузка: журнал на 100 000 строк за 1 с (критерий REQ-001, на который опирается страница) — перемерьте правило чтения и построение офиса на своём сгенерированном журнале. Перепроверьте не меньше 2 проб из приложения A или своих (P9 — настоящий Chrome: если Chrome есть и порт свободен, запустите; иначе назовите, чем заменили). Вердикт по вопросу проектировщика 12: office-report.js лежит в public/, чтобы остаться внутри write set REQ-007 — допустимо ли это или его надо вынести (тогда правка требования — работа REQ-ANALYST, не ваша).

ОГРАНИЧЕНИЯ ПРИ ПЕРЕПРОВЕРКЕ ПРОБ. Пробы, которые запускают настоящую сессию Claude Code (claude -p …), тратят лимит владельца: не больше одной такой пробы на вас, с самым коротким запросом и --max-budget-usd 0.5; остальное проверяйте без модели — поддельными данными хука, хешами, чтением файлов и документации. Не пишите в ~/.sai-pixel-office и в настоящие настройки (~/.claude, sai/.claude/settings.json): работайте во временной папке с подменой HOME. Не запускайте и не останавливайте ничего на порту 4780 без нужды; если нужен сервер — свободный порт. Каждая команда с таймаутом: предыдущие проверяющие уже останавливались из-за зависшей команды.

result.summary: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, WF-02 step 1b, REQ-007 part of docs/design/REQ-001-pixel-office.md (2.3, 3.5-3.8, 4.4-4.7, 10.2 LY/OF, 10.4, 10.6, 14, App. A P9; I also read the whole 2,217 lines). VERDICT: FAIL. Six blocking findings (F1-F6). All are fixable by text in the design (no restructuring); nothing is wrong in the grid, the model rules, the R2 chain or the write-set boundaries. A re-validation needs only the changed passages. Ruling on open question 12: ALLOWED, keep office-report.js in public/ (details at the end). == WHAT I VERIFIED MYSELF AND FOUND SOUND == 1. Criteria -> checks. All 8 REQ-007 criteria are mapped in 10.3 and every named item exists. Script over 10.2: 119 test rows; the 28 IDs used by the REQ-007 table (OF-01..16 except OF-14, LY-01..07, PG-10/20/21, SV-17/18, HK-07) all exist; U1(i), step T and the ls command exist. OF-14 is mapped only through E28 (fine). Text under design = validated text: REQ-007 block with status restored hashes to b0a739b4... and REQ-001 block (lines 6-276 plus newline, status restored) to d0641025..., the REQ-VALIDATOR r4 hashes. 2. No implementation code. The 34 indented blocks are the file tree, JSON shapes, the ASCII map (data = the MAP constant), shell commands and probe logs. grep for function / => / const / let / return / import / export finds only the word 'await' in prose (REQ-001 part, line 1080). No speculation phrases (Q3). 3. Quality-bar section 11: Q1-Q14 and R1-R3 all present, every 'не применяется' has a reason. No guard-from-action split found in my sections; no clash with decisions 0002/0003 (D1-D10 are proposed as a new record). 4. Grid and path-finding, my own script with the map EXTRACTED from design lines 869-889 and the reference tests/layout.js checks plus the design formulas: 27x21, only #.D, 24 desks = 96 D cells, all in 2x2 blocks, no stray D; 379 floor cells, all connected; seat (4+6k,3+3r) and approach (5+6k,3+3r) = seat+1 exactly as in osnova; 552 desk-to-desk routes are shortest (max 34 steps, about 10 s one way at 3.4 cells/s), every step is 1 cell; 285,984 walker samples at 1/60 s with Math.round: 0 not walkable; findPath gives [] for start=goal and null for desk, wall, outside and a walled-in goal via injected isWalkable. .claude/agents has 23 files, so LY-06 holds (24 >= 23+1). 5. R2 / AP-002 / one stream / page reads only. Office = pure function of the entries array; no simulation mode, only the source mark; marked lines never reach tasks, states, sessions, routes or card (PG-10, OF-05, OF-06); the page has one GET wrapper (PG-15, OF-11, PG-17). Page rules reach the office files: PG-20 scans every file in public/, SV-17 and SV-18 cover every served file. 6. Real payloads through the design: the P2 and P8 hook logs of the designer (read-only) passed through the 3.2 allowlist and my prototype of 4.2-4.5. P8 (2.1.286, the shape of the U1 session): exactly 2 routes (handoff main->general-purpose, result general-purpose->main), role working=false, 1 completed task with description, both main rows closed by Stop - so the U1(i) conditions are reachable. P2 (parallel + nested + foreground): 8 routes, the nested handoff has walker general-purpose (the caller's agent_id) and target Explore. Docs hooks.md (HTTP 200, lines 267 and 743) confirm agent_id/agent_type semantics. 7. Write set (item 6). Every file the design plans for REQ-007 lies inside the paths ORCH declared for PO-20260930-01 (handoffs/BP-20260930-01/parallel-runs.jsonl line 3: tools/src/pixel-office/, tools/test/ (whole dir), tools/eslint.config.js, tools/package.json, tools/README.md, .claude/settings.json ...). snapshot.js, cli.js, .claude/agents/ untouched (LY-06 only reads agents/). ISS-0002 also declared tools/test/ but its files are disjoint. Open question 1: tools/test/pixel-office-helpers.js is inside the declared tools/test/, is new, and npm test runs only "test/**/*.test.js" (verified in tools/package.json), so it is not executed as a test; the REQ text literally says '*.test.js', so ORCH should record the helper as allowed. Footprint note in F5. 8. Load (item 7). My own prototype of the written rules (4.1-4.5), journals of 100,000 lines generated here, Node 22.21.1. Generator A (the design's: arrival time + uniform +-59 s, 15.5 h span): read rule 9.5-12.7 ms; read rule + tasks + main rows + sessions + journal rows 37-62 ms; buildOffice 13-19 ms; total 50-81 ms against the 1 s limit. Generators B (+-100 ms) and C (dense, 5 ms spacing) the same order. With 5 forged lines (+-1 h at lines 1111, 26525, 54005, 68643, 79872): read rule 37-58 ms, total <= 100 ms, and exactly those 5 lines marked in all three generators. The fast algorithm of 4.1 equals the literal definition on 30,000 random journals (26,836 with conflicts, ties, SIMULATION lines, null entries): 0 mismatches; the README table reproduces (k=m: real lines marked; m=k+1: forged marked). Page side: 17.2 MiB response, JSON.parse 34-66 ms, shape+time validation 48-53 ms. Beyond the criterion, k forged lines at +1 h: 50 -> 68 ms, 500 -> 336 ms, 2,000 -> 1.1 s, 5,000 -> 2.8 s, 20,000 -> 8.1 s (design 13.9 is right). Caveat: measured on my prototype of the written rules, not on the future code; PG-08 will measure that. 9. Probes re-checked. No claude -p session was run (no owner limit spent). P9 re-run with my own scratch page and server (port 0) in Google Chrome 154.0.8037.59 with the design's exact U3 flags: the module graph (index -> boot -> app -> model/office/layout), fetch, canvas, a 2 s poll and an animation loop work under the 5.4 CSP; a description '' stays text (no img element in the DOM dump); setAttribute('style') gives a CSP console line, element.style via CSSOM is allowed; Chrome does not block port 4780 (client-only attempt to the free port gave ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED, not ERR_UNSAFE_PORT; I started nothing on 4780). P2 and P8 re-analysed from the raw logs: tool_response.agentId == SubagentStart.agent_id 4/4 and 1/1; the nested PostToolUse (P2 event 17) carries the caller's agent_id/agent_type, main-session ones carry none; order differs between 2.1.284 and 2.1.286. P0 commands re-run: claude not in PATH, EXECPATH = 2.1.284 binary, Node 22.21.1 / 25.2.1, git root <общая папка>, no sai/.git, no managed settings dir, no pixel-office in any settings file (find|grep exit 1), no ~/.sai-pixel-office, 23 agent files. == BLOCKING FINDINGS (all must be closed for PASS) == F1 [HIGH] office-report.js has no defined input semantics and no failure paths. Sections 2.3 l.532, 3.8 l.713-724, 10.4 U1(i) l.1721-1726, 8 l.1282-1348, 11 Q10 l.1848, OF-13 l.1641. It is the only check of REQ-007 criterion 7 (R2). Undefined: what --session filters (the entries before the model is built, or only the output); where serverStarts come from (buildModel needs them, the CLI has no argument for them); nowMs; exit codes. Section 8 has no row for the CLI and OF-13 tests only success, although the design's own AP-014 class rule (l.1337-1348) puts every fs call under tools/src/pixel-office behind a typed error with a Russian message, and Q10 asks a test with a simulated failure per external call. With other sessions in the journal the UAT outcome depends on the builder's guess; a missing file would give a stack trace. FIX: define in 3.8/10.4: --journal required, --session optional; model built from the whole journal (marks over the whole file), report limited to tasks with that session_id, their routes, and events/trusted counts of that session; serverStarts read from server-starts.jsonl next to the journal if present, else []; nowMs = Date.now(); exit 0 ok / 1 runtime / 2 usage; messages in Russian on stderr, no ' at ' lines; never writes the journal. Add E30 (no file, directory, unreadable, empty, corrupt lines skipped with a count, unknown session, no arguments) and tests OF-17a-f (stdout empty or JSON, stderr has Cyrillic and no stack, exit code, journal sha256 unchanged); add them to the Q10 row. F2 [HIGH] Movement semantics across polls are undefined and no test can see them. 2.3 l.529, 4.5 l.942-949, 3.6, OF-08 l.1636, OF-15 l.1643. Sim.sync(office) is 'ставит персонажей на места'; it must run again when a new role appears, and read literally it puts every character back on its seat at each poll, so walkers snap back every 2 s. Nothing says what sync does with a walking or queued character or with a role whose desk changed. The order of routes handed to enqueue is undefined although 'первым пришёл - первым идёт'. App (l.531) has no accessor to the sim or office, so OF-15 cannot observe the queue; OF-08 runs the sim without the app. The bug would pass every listed test. FIX: define sync = add missing characters at their seats, drop vanished ones, re-seat only a character with no queue and a changed desk, never touch a walking or queued one; routes sorted by event_index ascending (tie: handoff before result); add App.getOffice() and App.getSim() (read only); new test OF-18: a walker mid-route + a poll that adds unrelated events -> position and route unchanged, no duplicate; OF-15 observes through getSim().positions(). F3 [MEDIUM] Canvas labels were never checked against real role names. 4.5 l.957-958, 3.6 l.692. For custom agents agent_type is the frontmatter name, not the file name (hooks doc, SubagentStart); here they are like 'Sai Test Design Validator (TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR)', up to 49 characters. Measured with ctx.measureText in Chrome 154 on the 23 real names: at 8 px system-ui the labels are 98-219 px wide and 13 of 23 are wider than the 144 px desk spacing; at 10 px 119-267 px and 19 of 23; so neighbouring labels in a row overlap, and a label centred on an outer column crosses the 648 px canvas edge for 1 of 23 names at 8 px and 5 of 23 at 10 px. The design draws 'подпись роли' as it is; every test uses 'role-x'. FIX: add a label rule to 4.5 (for example the text of the last parentheses if there is one, else the name cut to 16 code points plus '...', full name only in legend and card, fillText gets maxWidth) and a test OF-19 with the real longest name (fillText text <= 16 characters, labels of one desk row do not overlap). F4 [MEDIUM] Contracts between index.html, app.js, texts and tests are incomplete for legend, card, click and drawing. 4.7 l.1006-1007 and 1009-1024, 2.3 l.525/527/530, 3.6/3.7, LY-05 l.1621, OF-10 l.1638. (a) The legend and card rows name no classes or data attributes for their parts ('списки in-progress, recent-completed, recent-events' are not said to be classes or ids) although l.1026 says a test may find elements only by names from the tables. (b) texts.js is called 'все надписи' with 'полный перечень' in 4.7, but '(роль не указана)' (3.5), 'показано из ' (4.6/4.7) and the card headings are missing; whether the number in the main label ('с числом sessions_running') is part of label or only a badge is unclear. (c) Click path: no coordinate conversion (canvas may be CSS-scaled; the reference uses getBoundingClientRect), no event or fake-canvas shape, hitTest px vs cell units, cell centre vs corner, and no tie rule although a walker on the approach cell (seat+1) overlaps the hit box of the seated character. (d) LY-05 'каждая клетка закрашена цветом своего вида' has no draw-call contract. (e) DESKS.cell is undefined (top-left of the 2x2?); Card.recent_completed 'новые первыми' has no key (MainRow has no end_index). FIX: in 4.7 give explicit classes/data attributes for legend items and card parts; complete texts.js; click = (clientX-rect.left)*canvas.width/rect.width, hit box around the cell centre (x+0.5, y+0.5)*CELL, nearest wins, tie -> smaller desk_index, fake canvas provides getBoundingClientRect; export CELL_COLORS and require one fillRect(x*CELL, y*CELL, CELL, CELL) per cell before monitors and characters; define cell; add end_index to MainRow and sort by it. F5 [MEDIUM] Plan 14 contradicts the module graph and hides REQ-007's footprint. 2.1 l.449-454, 14 l.1950-1979, PG-21 l.1598. 2.1 says app.js imports office-model/office-sim/office-view; 14 builds app.js in step 5 and the office modules in step 6 and demands a green npm run check after each step. PG-21 (page test) needs office and card. The eslint block sits in REQ-007's row but boot.js (step 5) needs it. The write set stays inside ORCH's declaration either way.
